name: @saas-boilerplate/ai
description: Flask AI worker service (Option C async jobs)

scripts.test: sh ./scripts/run-python.sh -c "import pytest" 2>/dev/null && sh ./scripts/run-python.sh -m pytest -q || echo 'Skipping AI pytest (install apps/ai/requirements-dev.txt)'
scripts.lint: sh ./scripts/run-python.sh -c "import ruff" 2>/dev/null && sh ./scripts/run-python.sh -m ruff check app tests || echo 'Skipping AI ruff (install apps/ai/requirements-dev.txt)'
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('@saas-boilerplate/ai: python service — no compile step')"
